text:
Alex K: Heads-up — Aurora (on-prem) customer has a change window NEXT Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Work: model repack + runtime config tweak. Need deploy owner, smoke test plan, rollback readiness, and who will be on-call.

Taylor N: I can own the deploy. Will be oncall for the first 90m.

Irene (PM): Customer notified and OK with that window, small traffic expected. Confirm minimal downtime target: <=5m for inference traffic?

Taylor N: Yes aiming for <5m. We'll do a staged restart across nodes, not full cutover.

Lee Ops: Can you confirm KMS key rotation isn't touched? Last time certs caused delays.

Alex K: No KMS changes. Just swapping model artifact + config flag `enable_prefetch=true`.

Maria R: I'll run smoke and stability checks post-deploy. Quick checklist I'll follow:
1) `curl -sS https://aurora-proxy/health` expect 200
2) short gen smoke: `POST /v1/generate` with test prompt, 3 requests, check lat < 200ms p50
3) KV-cache warmup: run `python tools/warm_cache.py --model aurora`

Taylor N: Sounds good. Will push canary to 1 node first. If ok for 15m, roll the rest.

Lee Ops: Prepare rollback artifact names and exact command please. Last rollback was messy.

Taylor N: Rollback plan: restore docker tag `aurora:v2.3.1` -> `kubectl set image deploy/aurora-server server=registry/redwood/aurora:v2.3.1 --record` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/aurora-server -w`

Alex K: Add a toggle to the config to reject new sessions if we're in rollback, so we avoid partial state.

Maria R: I'll have smoke script ready as a gist and a small runbook. Will post the run results in this thread.

deploy-bot: Deployment slot reserved: aurora-onprem-2027-03-10-02. Notified oncall group `eng-platform` and `aurora-customer-ops`.

Irene (PM): Customer escalation contact is Sam L (on-site). I'll DM Sam and include Taylor and Lee.

Taylor N: Quick question — do we need to re-run quantized build? The model repack might be a lighter artifact only.

Alex K: No quant rebuild this window. We're doing a repack with new tokenizer tweaks only.

Lee Ops: Network path checks: I'll run `iperf` between nodes 30m before window. Also will confirm firewall rules for the management IP.

Maria R: Smoke test snippet I'll use (will paste exact commands in the runbook):
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
curl -f https://aurora-proxy/health
python tests/smoke_inference.py --model aurora --requests 3 --max-latency-ms 200
```

Taylor N: Plan for communications: I'll post start, mid-roll, and done messages in this thread. If rollback happens I'll tag `@eng-platform` and `@oncall`.

Irene (PM): Thanks all. Please ack when you have runbook links and rollback artifact confirmed. I want final thumbs-up by EOD Friday.

Alex K: Acknowledged. I'll add the runbook link here once pushed.

Maria R: Runbook uploaded: https://internal.gist/runbooks/aurora-smoke-2027.md (will update with results).

Taylor N: Rollback artifact confirmed: `aurora:v2.3.1` present in registry and tested locally.

Lee Ops: I'll be online for the whole window.

Irene (PM): Great — closing loop for now. Final preflight checklist: runbook link, rollback artifact, iperf ok, oncall confirmed. If anything changes please update thread. :thumbsup:
